name: leantime-desktop
description: Unofficial desktop client for Leantime project management
//desktopName: Must equal the WM_CLASS Electron reports. Under X11 that is derived from the executable name (leantime-desktop), while on Wayland it is the app_id. Using the same value for both makes the .desktop filename, StartupWMClass, app_id and WM_CLASS all agree, which is what lets the desktop environment match a running window to its launcher icon.
